A.    Answer the following questions.
                            1.   How were glass bangles made in Ravi’s small
                                 workshop?
                            2.   Who was Ananya? How did she help Ravi?
                            3.   How did the success of the new bangles help
                                 the community?


                      B.    Think and discuss
                            1.   If you were in Ananya’s place
                                 what other modern designs or
                                 colours would you add to make
                                 the bangles more attractive?
                            2.   Ravi and Ananya felt proud
                                 seeing people wearing their
                                 bangles on Diwali night.
                                 Have you ever created something
                                 (drawing, writing, or a project)
                                 that made you happy? Share
                                 your experience with the class.
                            3.   Make a list of things that you
                                 buy from local markets during
                                 festivals.

                                                                            Glass Bangles   123
